rationale: Selected open_tie_13 (no shedding) and shed_bus3_15 (15 MW) to remove the 18 MW overload on l12. This combination achieves feasibility with minimal shedding: l12 flows to 96 MW (within 100 limit), l23 flows to 78 MW (within 90 limit). Total load shed is 15 MW, which is the minimum required to satisfy all constraints with at most 2 actions.
